name: My Son Sanctuary
description: Hidden in a green mountain-ringed valley in central Vietnam, about 68 km southwest of Da Nang, Mỹ Sơn is a cluster of ruined brick temple towers built to honour Shiva. Champa kings held ceremonies and were buried here for roughly nine centuries. Over 70 temples once stood in the valley, and many were wrecked by bombing in a single week of the Vietnam War.
